Love from Pip and Kip

Being kinder to our planet

Hi, I'm Bronwen and I'm passionate about making a positive difference to the planet by reducing the amount of waste and choosing more sustainable options. Even small changes can make a difference.

Have you ever looked at the huge pile of wrapping paper on Boxing Day and thought "There must be a better option than using all this paper?"

An idea came to me: make beautiful, reusable fabric gift bags that are eco-friendly, sustainable and reduce paper waste. Using these instead of paper is an easy way for each one of us to make a difference and be kinder to our planet. All profits from the sale of my bags will go to the cat rescue charity I support: K&K's Pawfect Haven.

Who are Pip and Kip?

Pip and Kip are our two rescue cats, Pippi and Kipling. Pippi comes all the way from New Zealand. She was born with a congenital eye defect and dwarfism, which both add to her cuteness.

Kipling is a boy we lifted from the streets of Birmingham in the depths of winter. He stood out because he was the only kitten amongst all the stray cats. He's a sweet boy with the softest fur and he now has a forever home with us.

All my proceeds from the Etsy store go straight to cat rescue efforts.
